content_html: Thank you *very much* for recording this, Jeffrey! It’s great to have a view into the beginnings of this conference for those of us unable to attend.
Is it possible to get access to the video source for people who want to watch these videos on Xbox or Ipods? Maybe a torrent?

Thank you for the videos…
At least what you discuss here will not be under NDA 🙂

Thanks .. I missed this ALT.NET Conf. and happy to see most of our old(first ALT.NET attendees) there.
Thanks again….
Hope to see the session videos too….

Other than that it’s not the most flattering view of me :-S thanks for taking and sharing this video, Jeffrey!

…Doc
